name: DocketEntry
description: A docket entry in a Federal Circuit case as accessible via PACER, representing a filing or court action in the case record.

docket_number.description: PACER docket identifier for the case.

date_filed.description: Date this docket entry was filed.

description.description: Description of the docket entry filing or court action.
description.example: BRIEF filed by Appellant Acme Corp. Service: 01/15/2025

pacer_doc_id.description: PACER document identifier for accessing the filed document.

page_count.description: Number of pages in the filed document.

is_sealed.description: Whether this docket entry is sealed from public view.
